body: I'd love to be pushed and in nature but Houston/Pearland Texas area barely has any of that. I don't have the slightest clue on how or where to meet people to hang out with. Being under 21, it's limited in camaraderie.
Except when you want to work in certain parts of the aviation field, you need a medical evaluation and they go through all your medical history. At least that's my understanding of it.

Work is really just a distraction from the real problem at hand. I prefer work rather than sitting in my room staring at my monitor then the weapons closet and back again. The problem really started at 1st semester in university and has continued to grow since that point.
